_meta.derived_from: wstg_project_config.json + a full manual read of every script
_meta.title_convention: Every io entry's "title" is a real filename, not a generic category label. For a recurring EXTERNAL reference file (the services JSON, the how-to bridge JSON, etc.) it is that file's one actual name, consistent everywhere it's referenced — look up "type" in artifact_catalog for the schema/format and every item that uses it. For a Burp/nmap XML capture, it is either the script's own real, already-fixed default filename (e.g. session_walk.xml, busl_01.xml), or — where the script requires the operator to name the file themselves, with no fixed default — a short name hinting at what THIS test's capture is of (e.g. info_leak.xml for INFO-05's information-leakage review, execution_paths.xml for the workflow- circumvention items). "type" stays filled in either way so the underlying XML dialect (proxy history vs. Intruder results vs. nmap -oX) is never lost. Any other already-fixed, item-specific filename (e.g. intruder_alerts.json) is used as-is; "type" is null for those.

burp_proxy_xml.title: (generic) Burp Proxy History XML
burp_proxy_xml.description: Standard Burp Suite proxy-history export. Decoded via the near-universal decode_element() helper used across the repo: <item><url/><method/><request base64="true"/><response/></item>. See the item's own "title" for what this specific capture is of.

burp_intruder_xml.title: (generic) Burp Intruder Results XML
burp_intruder_xml.description: Burp Intruder attack-results export — a distinct dialect from the proxy history export, adding <serialNumber/>, <status/>, <responselength/>, <payload/> and sometimes §marker§ payload-position syntax in the stored request.

burp_session_walk_xml.title: (generic) Burp Session Walk XML
burp_session_walk_xml.description: A single authenticated user's Burp proxy-history walk, captured specifically for session/cookie analysis (SESS-01/02).

burp_peruser_walk_xml.title: (generic) Burp Per-User Walk XML Set
burp_peruser_walk_xml.description: A directory of per-user Burp proxy-history walks, filename convention <username>_walk.xml, used for cross-user authorization comparison (ATHZ-02).

burp_channel_walk_xml.title: (generic) Burp Channel-Walk XML Set
burp_channel_walk_xml.description: A directory of one baseline.xml plus multiple weakened-channel 'walk' XML captures (no_cookies, no_javascript, weak_tls, mobile UA, etc.), used to diff reachable endpoints per channel (ATHN-10).

nmap_scan_xml.title: (generic) Nmap XML Scan Output
nmap_scan_xml.description: nmap's own -oX machine-readable output — a different XML dialect from the Burp exports used everywhere else in the repo.

services_json.title: svc_repo.json
services_json.description: Ports[] → PotentialServices[] → {Service, DefaultEndpoints, CommonEndpoints, UndesirableEndpoints} schema ('services JSON').
